newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair to end Lufthansa coop.
newsitem.headline: Finnair to end Lufthansa coop.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said in a statement on Monday its cooperation agreement with German Lufthansa would end on October 25 based on a mutual agreement between the companies.
Finnair said its flights to destinations in Germany -- 55 flights in all per week -- would remain unchanged while some timetables would change.

The cooperation between the two airlines has covered timetables, marketing and sales and frequent flyer programmes. Finnair said the frequent flyer cooperation would remain in force until the end of this year.
